I farm this rice plot every year and I know what works for me here in the South East. Last season I used NPK and a small bag of urea on my rice and the harvest was fair, so I will do the same this year — rice without fertilizer here gives almost nothing. I cannot afford improved seed every season, but I kept good seed from last harvest from the improved variety I bought two years back, so I will plant that again. I will spray once for the stem borer and weeds because rice without weeding is finished, and my wife and children will help me with most of the work, but I must hire some people for transplanting and harvesting because 0.67 ha is too much for just us at those times.
